title: ProteinMetadataRecord
description: Schema for individual protein metadata record in protein_metadata.tsv.gz

genome_id.description: Identifier of the genome or MAG (e.g. GCA_000008085.1)

contig_id.description: Contig or scaffold name within the genome

gene_id.description: Unique deterministic gene ID formatted as {genome_id}___{contig_id}___gene{order:05d}

protein_id.description: Unique deterministic protein ID formatted as {genome_id}___{contig_id}___prot{order:05d}

aa_length.description: Length of predicted amino acid sequence

translation_table.description: Genetic code translation table (e.g., 11 for Bacteria/Archaea)

gene_calling_tool.description: Software used for gene calling (e.g., pyrodigal)

gene_calling_version.description: Version string of gene calling software
